notes.root_cause: A form-document table (collection) node carries columns[].subKey — R-4 channel 2. A subKey is a SUB-key of the parent collection: it lives in record_schema.properties[collection].items.properties (a NESTED level), NOT among the top-level Object.keys(properties). BOTH the server classifier (floor-boundary.ts scanDocument) and the client V-SUBKEY handled this wrong in the live path: the server flattened subKeys into the same KEY_SET as top-level fieldKeys and checked them against resolveLiveSchemaFieldKeys() (top-level only) — so EVERY column of any collection («Позиции».qty/product) read as a dangling binding -> Floor-2 -> 409 WRONG_FLOOR. Live-proof T-0678 had to DELETE the «Позиции» table to get a clean POST 201.
notes.fix_server: floor-boundary.ts: split channel-2 out of the flat keySet into scan.collectionSubKeys ([{collectionKey, subKey}]). R-4 now (a) checks primary fieldKey/displayField vs top-level fieldKeys (unchanged); (b) for each column subKey: dangling iff parent collectionKey NOT in live keys (real dangling table — also caught by channel 1), OR a KNOWN sub-schema is supplied for that collection and the subKey is absent from it (real bad column). If no sub-schema is supplied for a LIVE parent collection, the subKey is COVERED by the parent binding (not dangling). Wired a new resolver resolveLiveCollectionSubKeys (live-form-schema.ts) that reads record_schema.properties[k].items.properties for array-of-object collections (multi-select items:string is correctly NOT treated as a collection), threaded into LiveSchemaView.subKeysByCollection in binding.ts classifyLayoutSave.
notes.fix_client: form-document.js V-SUBKEY: when the collection field IS present in the schema (V-KEY + V-CONTRACT already passed) but its subFields did NOT survive the round-trip (subByKey has no/empty entry for that key), the columns are covered by the parent collection binding and are NOT flagged. A KNOWN non-empty sub-schema is still fully enforced (a real bad column errors; a top-level dangling fieldKey is caught by V-KEY).
notes.not_weakened: Real dangling is UNCHANGED: (server) a table bound to a non-existent collection -> Floor-2 (channel 1); a column subKey absent from a KNOWN collection sub-schema -> Floor-2. (client) same via V-KEY + V-SUBKEY-on-known-sub-schema. Negative tests pin all four cases.
